The '''Battle of Corulag''' was fought between the [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. [[Oron Jaeger]], an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] received a head injury during the battle, requiring him to undergo [[AJ^6 cyborg construct|cyborg augmentation]].<ref name="Legacy Campaign Guide" />
